summary: Successfully implemented KAFKA-20223: Extended I/O Metrics Collection. Added 5 new Linux I/O metrics (rchar, wchar, syscr, syscw, cancelled_write_bytes) to the existing metric collection infrastructure. All metrics are exposed as Gauge types and collected from /proc/self/io. Both test suites passed: LinuxIoMetricsCollectorTest (3 tests) and MetricsTest (13 tests, including the critical testLinuxIoMetrics validation).
